name: What is the typical timeframe for a condo remodel project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a condo remodel project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a condo remodel varies significantly based on the scope of work. A minor cosmetic update, like painting and new flooring, might take 2-4 weeks. A full kitchen or bathroom renovation could extend to 6-10 weeks, while a complete gut renovation of an entire condo often requires 3-5 months or more. This timeframe includes design, material selection, permitting (if required), and construction. We provide a detailed project schedule before starting any work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Condo remodel timeframes range from a few weeks for minor updates to several months for full renovations, depending on scope.
